reason: A DSH Web GUI plugin that improves chat layout by folding consecutive tool calls into expandable summaries with configurable grouping, visibility, animation, and persistence settings.

summaries.zh: 通过将连续的工具调用折叠为可展开的摘要条，改善 DSH Web GUI 中聊天内容的布局与浏览体验。
summaries.en: Improves the DSH Web GUI chat layout by collapsing consecutive tool calls into expandable summary bars.

capabilities: Folds consecutive tool-call elements in the rendered DSH Web GUI
Observes rendered DOM changes to maintain folding behavior
Persists plugin settings through the DSH settings service or browser localStorage
Adds configurable expand/collapse animations and keyboard interaction
